summary: Invesco Real Estate Income Trust Inc. filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose its monthly net asset value and transaction price update. Total NAV as of September 30, 2026 was $669.0 million across 24,389,375 shares/units, with investments in real estate of $1,155.4 million offset by $479.7 million of mortgage notes and credit facilities and $431.9 million of non-controlling interests. The November 1, 2026 transaction price equals each class's September 30 NAV per share. There is no transaction, no solicitation, and no deal terms; this is an ordinary periodic valuation disclosure for a non-traded REIT.
